description: This file defines a Java class 'SavingsAccountBusinessEventSerializer' which implements the 'BusinessEventSerializer' interface. Its purpose is to serialize 'SavingsAccountBusinessEvent' objects into Avro format by retrieving savings account data and mapping it to an Avro DTO.

classes.name: SavingsAccountBusinessEventSerializer
classes.description: A serializer class that converts SavingsAccountBusinessEvent objects into an Avro-compatible format using data retrieved from the savings account service and mapped to an Avro DTO.

methods.name: canSerialize
methods.description: Checks if the given BusinessEvent is an instance of SavingsAccountBusinessEvent, indicating if this serializer can handle it.

methods.name: toAvroDTO
methods.description: Converts a BusinessEvent into an Avro ByteBufferSerializable object by retrieving savings account data and mapping it to the Avro schema.

methods.name: getSupportedSchema
methods.description: Returns the class type of the Avro schema supported by this serializer, which is SavingsAccountDataV1.
